```{r warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gmodels)
library(rstatix)
library(ggplot2)
library(ez)
```

### Import data

#### Read the csv file and claim the data type
```{r}

participant_id = c("0")

key_code = c("A", "S", "D", "F", "H", "J", "K", "L")

level_code = c("light", "medium", "mediumLow", "mediumHigh", "full")

# Initialize an empty data frame
trial_log = NULL

for (x in participant_id) {
  filename <- paste("./../results/", x, ".csv", sep="")
  trial_user_log <- read_csv(filename, col_types = cols(
    id = col_factor(levels = participant_id),
    level = col_integer(),
    block = col_integer(),
    trial = col_integer(),
    levelCounts = col_factor(levels = c("2", "3", "4")),
    targetKey = col_factor(levels = key_code),
    targetLevel = col_factor(levels = level_code),
    pressedLevel = col_factor(levels = level_code),
    pressedRaw = col_integer(),
    isSuccessful = col_logical(),
    startTime = col_double(),
    endTime = col_double(),
    time = col_double(),
  )) %>% filter(block != 0)
  trial_log = bind_rows(trial_log,trial_user_log)
}


```

### functions

```{r warning=FALSE}
percent <- function(num, digits = 2, ...) {      
  percentage <-formatC(num * 100, format = "f", digits = digits, ...)
  
  # appending "%" symbol at the end of
  # calculate percentage value
  paste0(percentage, "%")
}
```

### Total

#### block accuracy
```{r warning=FALSE}

log_block_accuracy <- trial_log %>%
  group_by(id, levelCounts, block) %>%
  summarize(
    accuracy_ave = sum(isSuccessful) / n(),
    n_trials = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(id, levelCounts, block)

log_accuracy_summary <- log_block_accuracy  %>%
  group_by(block, levelCounts) %>%
  summarize(
    meanAccuracy = accuracy_ave %>% mean(na.rm=TRUE),
    lowCIAccuracy = ci(accuracy_ave)[2] %>% pmax(0),
    highCIAccuracy = ci(accuracy_ave)[3] %>% pmin(1),
    sdAccuracy = ci(accuracy_ave)[4],
    stdAccuracy = sd(accuracy_ave)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(block, levelCounts)

log_accuracy_summary

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.3)
log_accuracy_summary %>% ggplot(
  aes(
    x = block,
    y = meanAccuracy,
    ymin = meanAccuracy,
    ymax = meanAccuracy,
    color = levelCounts
  )
) +
  geom_pointrange(position = pd) 

shapiro.test(log_block_accuracy$accuracy_ave)

qqnorm(log_block_accuracy$accuracy_ave); qqline(log_block_accuracy$accuracy_ave, col = 2)

```

```{r warning=FALSE}
trial_participant_wpm_graph

trial_participant_wpm_graph + theme( # remove the vertical grid lines
          panel.background = element_blank(),

          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
```

### Swipe Typing Usage

#### participant

```{r warning=FALSE}

swipe_usage_participant <-usage_log %>%
  filter(type == 'swipe')%>%
  summarize(
    meanusage = usage %>% mean(na.rm=TRUE),
    lowCIusage = ci(usage)[2]%>% pmax(0),
    highCIusager = ci(usage)[3]%>% pmin(1),
    sdusage = ci(usage)[4],
    stdusage = usage %>% sd())

swipe_usage_participant

usage_participant_graph <- ggplot(usage_log, aes(fill=type, y=usage, x=pid, label = percent(usage, 1))) + 
  geom_bar(position=position_stack(reverse = TRUE), stat="identity", width=0.5) +
  geom_text(size = 3, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE, vjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_discrete(breaks = c('tap', 'swipe')) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('tap' = "#2ECC71", 'swipe' = "#3498DB"))

usage_participant_graph

usage_participant_graph + theme( # remove the vertical grid lines
          panel.background = element_blank(),

          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y=element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

ggsave("usage participant.pdf", width = 20, height = 10, limitsize = FALSE)
```

### word

#### accuracy
```{r warning=FALSE}

word_accuracy <- word_log %>% 
  group_by(count, category, .drop = FALSE) %>% count()

word_accuracy_summary <-word_accuracy %>%
  group_by(count) %>%
  summarize(
    ratio = n / sum(n),
    n_trials = sum(n),
    category = category,
    n = n,
    )%>%
  ungroup()

word_accuracy_summary

word_accuracy_summary_top1 <-word_accuracy_summary %>%
  filter(category == 'top1') %>%
  group_by(count) %>%
  summarize(
    top1_accuracy = sum(ratio),
    )

word_accuracy_summary_top3 <-word_accuracy_summary %>%
  filter(category == 'top1' | category == 'top3') %>%
  group_by(count) %>%
  summarize(
    top3_accuracy = sum(ratio),
    )

word_accuracy <- left_join(word_accuracy_summary_top1, word_accuracy_summary_top3, by = "count") 
word_accuracy

```

#### time
```{r warning=FALSE}

word_time_summary <-word_log %>%
  filter(category == 'top1' | category == 'top3' | is_match) %>%
  group_by(count, usage) %>%
  summarize(
    meanTime = time %>% mean(na.rm=TRUE),
    lowCITime = ci(time)[2]%>% pmax(0),
    highCITime = ci(time)[3],
    sdTime = ci(time)[4],
    stdTime = time %>% sd()) %>%
  ungroup()

word_time_summary

# line + dot
word_time_graph <- ggplot(word_time_summary) +
  geom_pointrange( aes(x=count, y=meanTime, ymin=lowCITime, ymax=highCITime,color=reorder(usage, desc(usage))), alpha=0.9, size=0.8, position=position_dodge(width=1.0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0.0,10.0), breaks = seq(0, 10.0, by = 2)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("swipe" = "#3498DB", "tap" = "#2ECC71"))

word_time_graph

word_time_graph + theme( # remove the vertical grid lines
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line( size=.1, color="gray" ),
          # explicitly set the horizontal lines (or they will disappear too)
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line( size=.1, color="gray" ),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x=element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y=element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

ggsave("time usage count.pdf", width = 11, height = 10)
```
